desc:
👍 LIKE = UPDATE

🎩 Welcome to FNAF World Multiplayer!

A fan-made recreation of the original FNaF World, aiming to recreate the original experience while adding multiplayer!

The game is currently in EARLY ACCESS and is not yet complete. Once the main game is finished, I plan to expand it with new areas, content, events, skins, and more!

🌲 Explore the world of FNaF World!
⚔️ Fight enemies and bosses!
🌟 Unlock characters and build your party!
🗺️ Find new areas and secrets!

Thumbnail by Deevee & Tsuika0_0
VioletSchmidt
Thank you Forsaken AR for letting us use Screampunk & Mechanical Mangle

FNaF World is a FREE game originally created by Scott Cawthon and is available on Game Jolt.

All original FNAF World characters, music, and assets belong to Scott Cawthon and their respective owners. This is an unofficial fan game and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Scott Cawthon.
 
If requested by Scott Cawthon or the relevant rights holders, this game will be taken down.
